data.description: Wolverine has an opportunity for an experienced quantitative trader/researcher to join a growing options market-making desk within a well-established firm. data.description:
Wolverine is looking for individuals motivated to learn the inner workings of a highly automated Market Making operation and eager to solve a broad range of problems within this segment of the financial markets.

Successful candidates can expect to sit on one of our trading desks and learn Wolverine's approach to systematic Market Making, taking active ownership of a portion of our portfolio to build your knowledge base while also working on contained quantitative projects. We believe strongly that through this process of experiential learning, you will gain a broader perspective on how market makers fit into the financial system, enabling you to have more impactful long-term contributions towards the development of our automated systems and trading philosophies. This extended training period leads directly into a role in which you will shift your focus away from the direct management of our portfolio and towards driving our pricing, micro-structure strategy, and other pursuits that rely on the combination of your quantitative skillset and business understanding.
data.key_responsibilities:
• Learn how to provide liquidity electronically to the marketplace and manage dynamic options exposures.
  • Maximize market making revenues through the management of settings and processes that affect our risk accumulations.
  • Conduct ad-hoc quantitative analyses within the domains of settings optimization, market microstructure research, key performance metric monitoring, and options pricing theory.
data.skills_knowledge_expertise:

  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Strong communication skills and a desire to work in a team environment
  • Self-starter and independent attitude
  • Demonstrated interest in financial markets and technology (finance background is not required and Options Education will be provided)

data.description:
We're looking for a self-motivated, technically sharp engineer to support the operational health of Wolverine Execution Services' (WEX) core trading systems. You'll partner with software and hardware engineering teams to monitor real-time system performance, troubleshoot production issues, and build tools that keep pace with a growing and increasingly complex technical environment.

This is a highly visible role in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment. Strong candidates are clear communicators, effective multi-taskers, and sharp problem solvers who stay focused under pressure.
data.key_responsibilities:
• Diagnose and resolve technical operational issues on live trading systems
  • Perform intraday troubleshooting of production systems, communicating status clearly to stakeholders
  • Set up and maintain monitoring tools across server hardware and software, using a mix of in-house and third-party tools to ensure system stability
  • Maintain production trading infrastructure, including databases, transaction servers, gateways, and web servers
  • Certify new exchange links, including FIX and other protocols
  • Work with vendors (exchanges, ECNs, etc.) to resolve production issues
  • Collaborate with Traders, Software Developers, and Network Engineers to deploy new strategies, reconfigure existing ones, and track changes
  • Partner with trading stakeholders and Software Developers to identify and implement systems and process improvements
  • Create and maintain performance reports for individual clients and the system as a whole
  • Document support processes, known issues, and workarounds
data.skills_knowledge_expertise:
Core requirements:
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with experience investigating critical issues in a live production environment
  • Experience using a relational database to store, manipulate, and access data
  • Ability to synthesize data from multiple sources to identify issues or trends
  • Ability to work collaboratively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Driven to iteratively improve systems and processes
Preferred:
  • Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline
  • Working knowledge of scripting, regular expressions, or the FIX protocol
  • Familiarity with Linux scripting
  • Familiarity with TCP/UDP protocols and network packet captures
  • Understanding of trading industry concepts and terminology

data.description:
The network team designs, implements, and supports the network infrastructure for Wolverine's proprietary real-time trading systems, including proprietary hardware platforms, with a focus on low latency. Network performance and redundancy are critical to the global trading operation. The Network Engineer will be part of a team that works with Wolverine's software engineers and traders to support the high availability of the electronic trading infrastructure.

This is a hybrid position, with a mixture of working from home and working in our Chicago office. The candidate is expected to be local to the Metropolitan Chicago area and will periodically travel to Chicago and New Jersey area data centers.
data.key_responsibilities:
• Design, engineer, and implement low-latency network solutions based on requirements from business stakeholders
  • Own and manage strategic projects to implement and optimize low-latency, high-performance network solutions at and between data center locations
  • Work with financial exchanges, brokers, and banks to implement network connectivity in shared colocation facilities
  • Carry out high-level analysis and troubleshooting of the network infrastructure
  • Respond to network requests and troubleshoot network failures to diagnose, isolate, and resolve complex problems, ensuring timely results and minimal disruption to operations
  • Perform network maintenance and system upgrades, including patches and hotfixes to address vendor bugs and vulnerabilities
  • Monitor system resource utilization and historical trends, and perform capacity planning
  • Provide the technical knowledge needed to ensure safe, effective, and efficient changes to the network infrastructure
  • Produce and maintain detailed technical documentation
  • Participate in the team's on-call rotation
data.skills_knowledge_expertise:
• Minimum of 6 years in a technical networking environment as a network engineer
  • Deep, hands-on experience with complex network designs and principles, including L2 switching and dynamic routing (OSPF, BGP, EIGRP) in complex environments, with advanced traffic steering, filtering, and route redistribution
  • Strong network security fundamentals: firewalling (ASA, Palo Alto), security zones and DMZ design, network ACLs, NAT, and site-to-site IPSec VPN
  • Solid knowledge of multicast (PIM, IGMP) and best practices for deploying it, including the delivery of real-time market data feeds
  • Extensive knowledge of network operating systems (IOS / NX-OS / EOS / PANOS based network devices)
  • Ability to troubleshoot network latency and packet-drop issues using monitoring, diagnostic, and packet analysis tools (e.g., tcpdump, Wireshark)
  • Meticulous attention to detail, with a proven ability to prioritize competing workloads and manage implementation schedules
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and the ability to work independently within a team structure
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to distill complex technical issues into clear, concise terms
  • Strategic thinking balanced with sharp day-to-day execution, and a commitment to continuous improvement

Preferred:
  • CCIE certification
  • Knowledge of exchange connectivity in financial trading environments
  • Experience working with financial exchanges, brokers, and banks
  • Experience with network automation; understanding of Python and Ansible
  • Experience with physical planning, implementing, and supporting space, power, and structured cabling within a data center environment
  • Experience troubleshooting fiber optic connectivity within and between data center locations

Bonus Points:
  • Hands-on experience with cloud services (AWS, GCP)
  • Understanding of network time synchronization protocols
  • Experience with databases and big data tools (e.g., MySQL, Splunk, InfluxDB, Grafana)
  • Experience with Linux shell utilities

We strive to be the experts of our own network, and this role is expected to operate with that mindset - including the willingness to invest the time needed to learn our environment in depth, and the humility to own and learn from mistakes.

We are currently only considering candidates who are presently authorized to work in the US for this position and who do not require visa sponsorship now or in the future.

data.description:
We are seeking an ETF Trading Support Engineer to work directly with our ETF market-making desk and technology teams.

This role focuses on configuring, analyzing, validating, and improving business logic across the trading lifecycle. You will develop a deep understanding of how market and system data translate into trading strategy improvements. You will also gain an appreciation for the operational complexities of running and maintaining production trading strategies. The work is hands-on: we are looking for someone who can build practical tools to enhance team productivity.

The role sits at the intersection of trading support and data analysis and is well suited for someone analytically minded, curious, and eager to grow in a fast-paced environment. Direct market-making experience is not required. Ideal candidates want to move closer to electronic markets and real-time decision-making and may come from finance, data analysis, technology, operations, or another quantitative field.
data.key_responsibilities:
Learn and Improve Trading Business Logic

·       Master the rules, configurations, and controls that drive ETF trading activity.

·       Support product onboarding, trading eligibility, venue configuration, ETF/reference relationships, and market-data dependencies.

·       Work with traders and stakeholders to develop strategy enhancements, controls, and workflows.

Analyze Production Trading Behavior

·       Use market data and order execution data to evaluate strategy behavior and develop execution quality metrics.

·       Build repeatable analyses to identify configuration issues, data-quality problems, implementation defects, and missed opportunities.

Improve Automation and Controls

·       Automate data-quality checks, configuration validation, and strategy health monitoring.

·       Support testing and feature deployments by defining expected outcomes and monitoring production results.

·       Maintain documentation of strategy rules and configuration dependencies.
data.skills_knowledge_expertise:
Required Qualifications

·       Experience working with SQL, relational data, or similar tools.

·       Experience analyzing data and drawing clear conclusions.

·       Experience with Python or another object-oriented programming language — enough to build lightweight tooling.

·       Exposure to automation technology such as Airflow or other open-source alternatives.

·       Strong problem-solving skills — able to break complex problems into logical steps.

·       Strong attention to detail and intellectual curiosity.

·       Clear communication with technical and non-technical colleagues.

·       Willingness to ask questions, learn quickly, and take ownership.

·       Comfort in a fast-moving environment with evolving requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in any of the following is helpful but not required:

·       Tableau or comparable data visualization tools.

·       Apache Arrow or comparable in-memory data technologies.

·       C# or comparable object-oriented programming languages.

·       Advanced Excel, automated testing, monitoring, or data validation.


What Success Looks Like

A successful candidate will grow into a trusted partner to traders and developers by understanding trading logic, identifying differences between intended and actual behavior, reducing manual processes through automation, and creating tools that support real trading decisions.

Candidates are not expected to be experts in every area on day one. We value solid fundamentals, curiosity, and people who pick things up quickly.
